lib/picture/brush-fidelity: A Photoshop reference capture is one fidelity target, cropped and read by Photoshop's own reading.
lib/picture/stamp-reference: The CPU reference paints Photoshop's probe presets, to compare with Photoshop's captures of them.
lib/picture/stamp-styles: A pack's importer reads Photoshop presets, and a pack may hold both apps'.
